title: Story Mode
description: A single-presentation demo capsule that shows only the immersive Story (reel) surface.

cards.title: Story mode
cards.body: Tap the right side to move forward. Tap the left side to go back.

cards.title: Full screen
cards.body: Story fills the phone. The progress bars at the top show where you are in the sequence.

cards.title: It plays itself
cards.body: Each card advances on its own after a few seconds. Pause any time with the playback control.

cards.title: Readable underneath
cards.body: Even though it animates, every word is pre-rendered in the capsule's HTML — safe to read without scripts.

cards.title: That's story
cards.body: Five cards, one sealed capsule. Tap the left side to replay from the start.
